name: AcSplitFormDatasheet
description: Used with the Form.SplitFormDatasheet property (Access) property to specify whether the user can edit contents of the datasheet while a form is displayed in Split Form view.

constants.name: acDatasheetAllowEdits
constants.description: The user can edit the contents of the datasheet.

constants.name: acDatasheetReadOnly
constants.description: The user cannot edit the contents of the datasheet.
